harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured a PAM limits drop-in (/etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf) capping its login sessions at 8,192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc), soft and hard. Verified enforcement via a real `su -` login session. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native systemd reboot, confirmed the connection dropped and the boot_id changed after recovery, and re-verified the account and its resource limits persisted post-restart.
actions_performed: Checked node1 OS (RHEL 10) and confirmed appworker did not already exist
Created appworker user with useradd -m
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile 8192 and soft/hard nproc 256
Confirmed pam_limits.so is active in /etc/pam.d/system-auth
Verified limits via `su - appworker -c 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'` showing 8192 and 256
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime for node1
Issued `systemctl reboot` via nohup/background so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming boot_id changed
Re-verified appworker account, limits config file, and enforced session limits after restart
Confirmed systemctl is-system-running reports 'running' after restart

evidence.summary: Confirmed no pre-existing appworker user, then created it with useradd -m and verified uid/gid via id

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d drop-in with nofile/nproc 8192/256, confirmed pam_limits active, and verified real login session (su -) reports ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256
Captured pre-restart boot_id (7223d5b7...) and systemctl is-system-running=running
systemctl reboot issued in background (ack returned), subsequent polls show connection timeouts/resets confirming the node actually went down

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is f377f98c..., differing from the pre-restart 7223d5b7..., proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of appworker account and limits
evidence.summary: After restart, appworker id resolves correctly, limits.d config file persisted, su - login session still shows ulimit -n=8192/ulimit -u=256, and system is fully running
